sloka: तं विह्वलन्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य रामः समाददे दीप्तमथार्धचन्द्रम् ।तेनार्कवर्णं सहसा किरीटं चिच्छेद रक्षोधिपतेर्महात्मा ।। ६.५९.१४१ ।।।।
transliteration: taṁ vihvalantaṁ prasamīkṣya rāmaḥ samādade dīptamathārdhacandram ।tenārkavarṇaṁ sahasā kirīṭaṁ ciccheda rakṣodhipatermahātmā ।। 6.59.141 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing Ravana swooning, great soul Rama took up a crescent shaped arrow and hastily broke his crown into pieces which were shining bright red like the Sun.
